source.source_text: prāñjalipraṇatāḥ sarve agrasthāḥ kiṃ prayojanam | etadanugrahād devi vada me parameśvari —

T1.close_translation: "[and]-the-hands-joined-bowed (*?), all, [and]-the-foremost-stood (*?), what-the-aim (prayojana)? [and]-by-your-grace, O-Devī, tell-me, O-supreme-mistress:" "[Devī:] What, indeed, O-supreme-lord, [and]-you-ask-me, O-skull-bearer (kapāla-dhṛk)? What, indeed, [is]-your-aim, [and]-what, indeed, [is]-the-question's-cause? What, indeed, [is]-to-you-...(*?) [X: "vahantyatāḥ?" corrupt], [and]-ask-you, indeed, [the]-supreme-Śiva: what, indeed, by-the-own-nature-being (*?), [and]-you-ask, indeed, O-great-minded:"
